name: Uppercase Selection
summary: Stateful extension demo (ABI v1.3): uppercase the selection through the editor read/write API · keeps a counter between calls · stores a total
description:
Reference sample for ABI v1.3 'stateful' extensions: the instance is kept between calls (stateful), the command 'Upper: Uppercase selection' reads the selected regions and queues replacements - the app validates and applies them as one undo step (editor.write is shown at install time and confirmed on first use). A session counter lives in the instance; a total counter is kept in the extension's own state.json. It also subscribes to caret events and logs every 10th one.
Built from extensions/sdk/samples/uppercase-selection with nexa-ext-sdk 0.4.
author: SosomLab

messages.install: Uppercase Selection is installed - select text and run 'Upper: Uppercase selection' (first use asks to allow editing the document).
